dialogues.speaker: Shana
dialogues.text: Oho... When you tear open the crispy skin, the shiny fishy flesh inside couldn't be more like freshly-made competition equipment if it tried...

dialogues.speaker: Shana
dialogues.text: And as an engineer, I'm the first person that gets to experience it!

dialogues.speaker: Shana
dialogues.text: ...Of course, our testing equipment is meant for safety inspections, which is a whole other kettle of fish from grilling, well, fish.
